clips.title: The story
paras: Lordamere Internment Camp is a former Second War detention facility perched on the heights overlooking Dalaran. Once built to confine lethargic orcs, the camp is now occupied by surviving Dalaran magi and guards alongside a treacherous band of Forsaken defectors.

Following the Second War, the Alliance constructed internment camps across the northern kingdoms to contain the defeated orcish Horde. Lordamere was unique as the sole camp established within the Alterac Mountains, placed under Dalaran's jurisdiction. With the orcs long since liberated or fled, the camp today functions under Warden Belamoore as an outpost for Dalaran remnants studying dangerous magical relics.
